name: Fakker
summary: An Arabic-first iOS app that keeps track of maintenance for your cars and, coming soon, your home appliances.
statusNote: In development now. Not on the App Store yet.
contributions: Log services, expenses, documents, and wishlist items for each car, and get reminders when maintenance is due.
Arabic-first with full right-to-left support, plus light and dark mode.
Home appliance tracking is coming soon.
